senses.gloss: m. pl. (prob. pl. of ארונא, so called from closing and opening like chests) name of certain plants growing in marshes and closing their leaves at nightfall.
units: Sabb. 35ᵇ בדברא עורבי באגמא חזו אדני Ms. M. (ed. עורבי א״נ אדאני …; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., Ar. הרני, Var. ארוני, Rashi ed. Sonc., Asheri a. R. Niss. early ed. אראני) in the desert you recognize the entrance of the Sabbath (on a cloudy day) by the ravens, in marsh-land you look out for aroné
